# National Insulation Association (NIA)

> The National Insulation Association provides comprehensive education, certification, standards, and industry resources for mechanical insulation professionals and organizations.

NIA is the leading trade association for the insulation industry, offering professional certifications, technical standards, market research, and networking opportunities for contractors, manufacturers, and specifiers. The organization focuses on energy efficiency, decarbonization, and advancing mechanical insulation practices across commercial and industrial applications.

## Key Topics

- Mechanical Insulation
- Energy Efficiency
- Thermal Performance
- HVAC Systems
- Insulation Standards
- Certification Programs
- System Design
- ASTM Standards
- Decarbonization
- Faced Insulation
- Commercial & Industrial Insulation
- Energy Savings
- Thermal Insulation Inspectors
- Insulation Energy Appraisers
- Industry Training

## Certification & Training Programs

- [NIA Certified Thermal Insulation Inspectors™](https://insulation.org/training-tools/nia-certified-thermal-insulation-inspectors): Professional certification program for thermal insulation inspectors with comprehensive training and credentials
- [NIA Certified Insulation Energy Appraisers™](https://insulation.org/nia-certified-insulation-energy-appraisers): Certification and IEAP program for professionals evaluating insulation energy performance and efficiency

## Insulation Standards & Technical Resources

- [NIA Insulation Standards](https://insulation.org/resources/nia-insulation-standards): NIA insulation standards and industry guidelines developed by SC 27 committee
- [North American Commercial & Industrial Insulation Standards Manual, 9th Edition](https://insulation.org/resources/technical-specifications/standards-manual-mica): MICA Manual with comprehensive commercial and industrial insulation standards and specifications
- [NIA Certified Faced Insulation Standard 404.2–2024](https://insulation.org/about-insulation/nia-certified-faced-insulation-404-2-2024): Latest NIA Certified Faced Insulation Standard with ASTM specifications and requirements
- [Specs & Codes](https://insulation.org/about-insulation/system-design/techs-specs): Technical specifications and ASTM standards for insulation materials and systems
- [Design Guide/MIDG](https://insulation.org/training-tools/systemdesign): Mechanical Insulation Design Guide with calculators and tools for engineers and specifiers

## Insulation Types & Applications

- [About Insulation](https://insulation.org/about-insulation): Overview of mechanical insulation, HVAC applications, and energy conservation principles
- [Insulation Types](https://insulation.org/about-insulation/insulation-types): Classification of insulation types including fibrous, cellular, flake, granular, and reflective materials
- [Benefits of Insulation](https://insulation.org/about-insulation/benefits-of-insulation): Comprehensive guide to insulation benefits including energy savings, ROI, and thermal performance
- [Metal Building Insulation](https://insulation.org/about-insulation/metalbuildinginsulation): Metal building insulation solutions with ASHRAE 90.1 compliance and installation guidelines
- [Residential Insulation](https://insulation.org/about-insulation/residential-insulation-3): Residential insulation guide with NAIMA referral and contractor directory

## Membership & Community

- [Join the National Insulation Association (NIA)](https://insulation.org/join-the-national-insulation-association-nia): NIA membership application with benefits, dues structure, and membership categories
- [Membership Directory](https://insulation.org/membership-directory): Searchable NIA member directory with company listings and industry specialties
